ModMetaData.name: Visual Exceptions (local 1.7 port)
ModMetaData.author: Andreas Pardeike; local 1.7 port
ModMetaData.description:
Local RimWorld 1.7 build of Visual Exceptions 1.4 (MIT, Andreas Pardeike), from upstream commit aa1fc51.
Upstream's ExceptionInfo bound Exception.ToString(bool, bool) (Mono-only) and HarmonyMod.ExceptionTools.ExtractHarmonyEnhancedStackTrace (renamed in the Harmony mod's 1.7 build) by reflection; both are gone on 1.7, so its type initialiser threw and crashed the game. This build replaces them with plain calls and drops CrossPromotion. Retire it once the workshop mod ships a 1.7 build.
